purpose: Teach: オシャレ/かまい/壊す/重宝/裕福/ばらばら/図鑑/妖怪

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、新しい服、すごくオシャレで、似合ってるよ、ぼく、ママ大好き。
lines.en: Mom, your new clothes are so stylish—they really suit you. I love you so much.
lines.style: Bright, uncomplicated admiration. Quick warm emphasis on 「オシャレで」. Then a softer, sincere drop on the declaration of love—not performative, just stated like a fact he's noticed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。汚れても、かまいませんから、外で、思い切り、遊んでね、翔くん。
lines.en: That's wonderful. Don't worry about dirt—go outside and play as hard as you want, okay Sho?
lines.style: Warm permission. Slight lift on 「かまいません」—actually freeing him, not just tolerating mess. Gentle, deliberate on his name at the end. The tone of someone giving him something he needs.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 玩具を、壊すと、悲しくなるよね、ぼく、大事に、するからね。
lines.en: When toys break, it makes me sad... but I'll take good care of it, I promise.
lines.style: Careful, thoughtful pause before the promise. Not anxious—just the quiet seriousness of a six-year-old making a deal with himself. Soft conviction on 「大事に」.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: おじいちゃんのアイデア、すごく重宝してるのよ、ママ、毎日。
lines.en: Your grandfather's idea has been so helpful. I use it every single day.
lines.style: Genuine warmth tinged with gratitude. A small smile in the voice. Not casual—she's reflecting on something that actually matters to her. Steady, grounded pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 裕福な家のお友達、ぼくに、優しくしてくれるよ、嬉しい!
lines.en: My friend from the wealthy family is so kind to me. That makes me really happy.
lines.style: Bright observation without envy or self-consciousness. Natural brightness on 「優しくしてくれる」. A small boy noticing kindness and being delighted by it—no complications underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お部屋、ばらばらに、おもちゃが、散らかってるわよ、片付けようね。
lines.en: Your room is scattered with toys everywhere, sweetheart. Let's tidy up together, shall we?
lines.style: Practical but not sharp. A gentle statement of the obvious. The 「ね」 makes it a soft suggestion, not a command. The rhythm of a mother who's done this many times and expects cooperation, not resistance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 昆虫図鑑、明日、学校に、持って行きたいんだ、ママ、いい?
lines.en: I want to bring my insect encyclopedia to school tomorrow, Mom. Is that okay?
lines.style: Direct, hopeful request. A small lift on 「持って行きたいんだ」—he's excited about this, wants to show it matters. The 「ママ、いい?」 is checking permission but with genuine hope underneath, not doubt.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 妖怪の絵本、お祖父ちゃんが、読んでくれるって、楽しみね、翔くん。
lines.en: Your grandfather is going to read you that yokai picture book. You must be so excited about that, Sho.
lines.style: Warm, almost conspiratorial. She's sharing his anticipation, not just stating facts. Gentle lingering on 「楽しみね」—she knows this matters to him, and she's letting him feel it with her.
